main_text.p: ad Hebr.1.3. [Hebrew] Ego ipse, ad Roman.9.3.
[Hebrew] Heb. Pihel Nidificare: Hinc in Aph. [Hebrew] Syr. Idem, Luc.13.19. Matth.13.32.
[Hebrew] Ch. Nidus, ut Hebr. [Hebrew] Nidus mellis, Favus, 1. Sam.14.22: cum n in fine, [Hebrew] Veluti nidum, Jesa.10.14.

[Hebrew] Chald. Punire, mulctare, mulctam imponere. Ithpehal [Hebrew] Multari, puniri, Deut.32.50. in Jon. & Exod.2.22. Ab Hebraeo [Hebrew] & ע & ק & ש & ס pro more inter se commutatis. Ex Pah. Part. [Hebrew] Quibus puniunt reos, Exo.16.25. in Jon.
[Hebrew] Chal. Poena, multa, [Hebrew] Multa pecuniaria, Exod. 21.30. Jonath. Plural. [Hebrew] Exod.15.25. Jonathan.
[Hebrew] Ch. Vela, conopia, vel conopea, A Graeco [Greek] 2. Sam. 16.22. Elias exponit [Hebrew] Tentoria. Sic Kimchius [Hebrew].
[Hebrew] Ch. Cribrum, vel crates, craticula, Exod. 27.4. in T.H. & 35.16. in Jonath. [Hebrew], Exod. 38.30. in Jonath.
[Hebrew] Chald. Urceus, urna, sextarius, mensura certa, continens duodecim logos: logus autem sex ova. Respondet Hebr. [Hebrew]. Est autem Graecum [Greek]. Vide Drus. Marci 7.4. [Hebrew] Plenam

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Greek words are copied as far as legible; the diacritics and some Hebrew letters in the small type are uncertain and were not reproduced exactly. Hebrew strings are marked here only, not individually.
